name: TEYU CW-3000TGTY spindle water cooler
evidence: Published 490 x 270 x 380 mm overall size and OD10 barbed ports. External contours, feet, handle and port coordinates are illustrative; no factory mounting holes or internal heat exchanger geometry are asserted.
spec: 220-240 V; 9 L reservoir; passive radiator 50 W/K, rated flow 6 L/min, maximum pump pressure 1 bar. No compressor. Verify spindle heat load, ambient temperature, pressure drop and flow alarm before selecting.

name: TEYU CW-5000TITY active spindle chiller
evidence: Published CW-5000TITY overall envelope 580 x 290 x 470 mm and 10 mm fast water connectors. Case divisions, ventilation slots, feet, handle and port locations are illustrative external installation geometry; factory mounting holes and compressor internals are not asserted.
spec: 220-240 V single phase, 50/60 Hz; active compressor cooling, nominal 750 W heat rejection, temperature stability +/-0.3 C, control range 5-35 C, 8 L reservoir, rated pump flow 10 L/min and maximum pump pressure 2.5 bar. These are separate rated values, not a guaranteed installed flow/capacity. Verify at least 5 L/min through the actual JST spindle, heat load, ambient/setpoint cooling capacity, condensation margin and the delivered alarm/interlock contacts before cutting.
